LanguageData.Hemodilution.label: hemodilution
LanguageData.Hemodilution.description: Diluted blood increases bleeding and reduces oxygen delivery; above 45%, it can drive cerebral hypoxia. Transfuse blood to reduce dilution. Saline restores volume but worsens dilution; forced single infusions bypass automatic safety checks.
